name: lapline
description: Phone-first second screen for F1 sessions: 3D circuit, timing tower and telemetry from OpenF1.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lapline/shared && npm run build -w @lapline/web && npm run build -w @lapline/server
scripts.clean: rm -rf apps/*/dist packages/*/dist tools/*/dist apps/*/*.tsbuildinfo packages/*/*.tsbuildinfo tools/*/*.tsbuildinfo
